Transits of Venus金星凌日

This catalogue is an extract from the Fourmilab Quarter Million Year Canon of Solar System Transits. Please see that document for further information. 

Planet  Name of planet transiting the Sun. 

Max-Transit Time  Date and time of maximum transit. 

C  Calendar: J = Julian, G = Gregorian 

Start  Julian date transit begins. 

Max  Julian date of maximum transit. 

End  Julian date transit ends. 

Sunrad  Angular radius of Sun as seen from Earth, degrees.  日角直径，由地球所看的太阳视角直径大小

Depth  Angular distance of Planet at maximum transit from centre of Sun. 凌日最大时太阳中心距离事件行星的角距离 

S  Is transit simultaneous with previous item in table?
